contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IVL CRIS-PVS NOB C ; R/ BEATA TRAN-QVILLITAS

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Crispus (317-326), Beata Tran-quillitas issue of 321-323, Reece period 16, Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped in imperial mantle holding globe and eagle topped sceptre. Obverse inscription: IVL CRIS-PVS NOB C. Reverse description: Globe on altar inscribed VO/TIS/XX, three stars over. Reverse inscription: BEATA TRAN-QVILLITAS. In exergue: STR…
